nodes.name: DB: Get Unpaid Invoices Due Soon

parameters.query:
SELECT
  mi.id          AS invoice_id,
  mi.tenant_id,
  mi.membership_id,
  mi.invoice_month,
  mi.total_amount,
  mi.amount_paid,
  mi.balance_due,
  mi.due_date,
  mi.status,
  m.plan_name,
  c.full_name    AS customer_name,
  c.email        AS customer_email,
  r.name         AS room_name,
  rr.start_time::text AS start_time,
  rr.end_time::text   AS end_time,
  rr.day_of_week
FROM bookings.membership_invoices mi
JOIN bookings.memberships m       ON m.id  = mi.membership_id
JOIN bookings.customers   c       ON c.id  = mi.customer_id
JOIN bookings.recurring_rules rr  ON rr.membership_id = mi.membership_id AND rr.active = TRUE
JOIN bookings.rooms r             ON r.id  = rr.room_id
WHERE mi.status IN ('unpaid', 'partial')
  AND mi.tenant_id = $1
  AND mi.due_date <= (CURRENT_DATE + ($2 || ' days')::INTERVAL)
  AND mi.due_date >= CURRENT_DATE
ORDER BY mi.due_date ASC;

parameters.query:
UPDATE bookings.membership_invoices
SET notes = COALESCE(notes,'') || ' [Reminder sent ' || NOW()::date || ']',
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $1::uuid
RETURNING id;
